hints: Ranked file#heading hits with an FTS5 snippet excerpt (keyword + graph, +vectors if PLAINKEEP_VECTORS). `--author human` excludes agent + derived material; `--author agent` keeps only agent notes (provenance planes). `--open` jumps to the top hit via `plainkeep open`; bare `plainkeep search` in a tty with fzf opens a live search session. Common mistake: running before `plainkeep index`, or too narrow a query — broaden and reindex.
